problem: The 103-model AI Modelwijzer merged to main, but production readback failed before deployment because its public root page, comparison clusters and model catalog were not classified by the delivery control plane.
root_cause: The Modelwijzer v2 content expansion added new public routes and a public data authority without extending the website-lane path registry in config/brain-delivery-system.json.
fix: Register the AI Modelwijzer root, comparison/provider clusters and canonical model catalog in the website lane and lock the complete set with a Brain delivery regression.
prevention: Every new public root route or public route family must be classified in the same candidate that creates it.
Public static data authorities consumed by a website surface must have an explicit delivery lane.
Production readback must stay fail-closed on unclassified paths.
